blind.description: A freestanding rectangular section of stone masonry wall with a stylized hand-painted texture. It consists of courses of warm tan and ochre ashlar blocks, accented by several dark grey blocks, a thin dark horizontal band running through the lower half, and a slightly projecting dark moulding course near the top just beneath a flat two-block stone coping. The geometry is clean, solid, and continuous with slightly bevelled edges and flat vertical sides.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangle with rounded corners, split centrally into two rectangular capstones.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.25 times as tall as the figure (roughly 7 to 7.5 feet tall) and about 3.5 feet wide.
